## Video Tutorial

{{< video https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GhuUnPmu5s0 >}}

## In this tutorial

How to geocode, i.e. add latitude and longitude to a CSV/tabular dataset that only contains addresses, which will allow you to plot the CSV on a map.

**Timestamps (Click a link to start that segment in a new window)**

[0:00 - 1:22](https://youtu.be/GhuUnPmu5s0?si=cJ-pC2hajWmknT2B): Looking at the dataset ([original](https://data.cityofnewyork.us/Education/COVID-19-Free-Meals-Locations/sp4a-vevi/about_data) and [modified version](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1SJbcNBIBlKuaPQJpg84D0APOFMLNIXNR/view) without lat and lon)

[1:22-6:01](https://youtu.be/GhuUnPmu5s0?si=0tZzw0tqhudOnDcH&t=82): Using the [Geocodio](https://geocod.io) tool to find lat/lon based on addresses in the dataset

[COVID meals dataset without latitude and longitude](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1SJbcNBIBlKuaPQJpg84D0APOFMLNIXNR/view) to practice
